description: THE REFUSAL of the delete of a FK whose AutoIndex still exists: in both lanes each FK is born with an automatic index (AutoIndex_<Attribute>) that counts as a consumer; without deleting the index first, the delete of the attribute is refused naming it, even without author consumers (the aggregate was deleted earlier). The clean path (delete the AutoIndex and then the FK) is in tests/jobs/entity-refactor.json (data batch, phase 3).
